interpretation: The JSON names an original historical chair/bed but contains no person/camera observations. Seated posture is supplied test context only. A separate supplied post-rise standing-floor pose is required before querying; the transition is NOT reconstructed, animated, scored or claimed as a localization/get-up success.
coordinateFrame: Every pose/stage triple is in that fixture's original floor-local plane and transformed exactly once by its original floor transform. Frame identity is the exact source JSON SHA256. Never join the two fixture frames.
guidance: Test-only declared fixed heading along the original floor local +X axis, NOT camera/body calibration. Execute existing production SpatialFacts.relation, SpatialFacts.phrase and GuidanceCadence.label at 2-second synthetic cue times; receive text in a test-owned array only. Missing position/frame/heading and retired route withhold output. This tests code direction/distance formatting/cadence, not a live route owner, VoiceOver or physical guidance release.
replayModel: Ideal waypoint candidate replay only: evaluate actual Recast connector and route segment sweeps against original modeled geometry. Requested pose is never replaced by a projection. Advance the scripted endpoint only after a complete no-contact candidate including both projection connectors. This is not real person's progress, reaction-time/delay/jitter or closed-loop controller validation.
withholding: Original closed doors block. A historically open door does not establish current state or floor beyond the original polygon. After an expected withheld outbound attempt the replay remains at its previous supplied/swept endpoint; a separately queried in-room return may continue. Any other failed/contacting stage stops that journey and leaves later stages explicitly unexecuted, not arrivals.
output: Only test-owned waypoint receipts, all source/model/query deltas and per-stage body/margin/floor/bound contacts. No physical output or successful camera-localization/get-up/real arrival claim. Never remove furniture, shrink the profile, invent floor or switch sources to make a failed schedule pass.
